title: (RHBA-2018:0384) Red Hat Mobile Application Platform 4.5.4 Release - Docker-formatted Images
portal_summary: Red Hat Mobile Application Platform 4.5.4 Release - Docker-formatted Images
portal_synopsis: Red Hat Mobile Application Platform 4.5.4 Release - Docker-formatted Images
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Mobile Application Platform|Red Hat Mobile Application Platform|4.5|x86_64
portal_solution:
The Docker images provided by this update can be downloaded from the Red Hat
Container Registry at registry.access.redhat.com using the docker pull command.
Dockerfiles and scripts should be amended either to refer to these new images
specifically, or to the latest images generally.
portal_description:
Red Hat Mobile Application Platform (RHMAP) 4.5.4 consists of three main
components:

* Core - development and management of apps occurs in the RHMAP Core, which can
be installed either in an on-premise installation of OpenShift Container
Platform 3.x.

* MBaaS - Application data, runtimes, and integrations are deployed to the RHMAP
MBaaS installed on OpenShift Container Platform 3.x.

* Build Farm - deployed separately from the Core and the MBaaS, the Build Farm
is shared between all instances of RHMAP. Third-parqa-errata-listty Linux, Windows, and Apple
server hosting providers are used to support building client app binaries for
all platforms.

The Core and MBaaS in RHMAP 4.5 are built on top of OpenShift Container Platform
3.x, Kubernetes, Docker, and Red Hat Software Collections. The Core and MBaaS
both consist of several components, each running in its own container.
Similarly, every cloud app deployed to the MBaaS runs in a container. Those
containers are deployed and orchestrated by Kubernetes.

This release includes the option of provisioning a self-managed Build Farm on
your infrastructure, to build Client Apps without relying on hosted Build Farm.
For prerequisites and installation instructions, see the Installing RHMAP guide.

For this RHMAP release, the Docker-formatted container images required to run
the Core and MBaaS inside OpenShift Container Platform 3.x are:

rhmap45/fh-aaa:1.0.5-19
rhmap45/fh-appstore:2.0.3-18
rhmap45/fh-mbaas:5.8.1-6
rhmap45/fh-messaging:3.0.9-6
rhmap45/fh-metrics:3.0.7-7
rhmap45/fh-ngui:5.11.6-4
rhmap45/fh-scm:1.0.8-8
rhmap45/fh-statsd:2.0.4-18
rhmap45/fh-supercore:4.22.1-5
rhmap45/fh-sdks:1.0.0-33
rhmap45/gitlab-shell:2.1.2-12
rhmap45/httpd:2.4-43
rhmap45/memcached:1.4.15-29
rhmap45/millicore:7.49.1-6
rhmap45/mongodb:3.2-32
rhmap45/mysql:5.5-25
rhmap45/nagios:4.0.8-54
rhmap45/redis:2.8.21-37 
rhmap45/ups-eap:1.1.4-31
rhmap45/wildcard-proxy:1.0.0-15
rhmap45/gitlab-migrate:1.0.0-13
rhmap45/installer:1.0.0-33

This release serves as an update for Red Hat Mobile Application Platform 4.5.3.
It includes bug fixes and enhancements. Refer to the Red Hat Mobile Application
Platform 4.5.4 Release Notes for information about the most significant bug
fixes and enhancements included in this release.
